# Level commands

<!-- ANCHOR: commands -->

## `xrf-cli level albedo`

Report how the base textures of a level's lit surfaces sit as albedo, against the range real materials span

```txt
xrf-cli level albedo [OPTIONS] <--path <path>|--root <root>>
```

| Option                 | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-p, --path <path>`    |          |         | Path to a compiled level directory, the one holding `level` and `level.geom`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `-r, --root <root>...` |          |         | Root holding an installation's levels. Repeat to layer roots, highest priority first                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `-l, --level <level>`  |          |         | Name of the level to read from the mounted roots, as `levels` knows it                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `--source <source>`    |          | `auto`  | How to read the path: auto treats it as an installation only when it declares one, directory ignores any declaration, volumes mounts every archive volume beneath it, installation requires one, containing-installation searches parent directories for one. Possible values: `auto`, `directory`, `volumes`, `installation`, `containing-installation`. |
| `-s, --silent`         |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `-v, --verbose`        |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `--json`               |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `--report <PATH>`      |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |

## `xrf-cli level build`

Build an SDK Level Editor scene's game files into a level directory, as the editor's Build writes them from the scene's
parts: level.game, level.env_mod, level.fog_vol, and level.spawn, level_rs.spawn, level.ps_static, level.snd_static,
level.snd_env and level.wallmarks where the scene holds them. No geometry or build.prj yet

```txt
xrf-cli level build [OPTIONS] --path <path> --dest <dest>
```

| Option              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `-p, --path <path>` | yes      |         | Path to the scene's .level; its parts are read from the directory beside it named after it |
| `-d, --dest <dest>` | yes      |         | Path of the level directory to write the files into                                        |
| `-f, --force`       |          |         | Overwrite the files the build writes where the directory already holds them                |
| `-s, --silent`      |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                           |
| `-v, --verbose`     |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                    |
| `--json`            |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                       |
| `--report <PATH>`   |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                      |

## `xrf-cli level decompile`

Decompile a compiled level's directory into an SDK Level Editor scene (.level and its parts), with a .level.xrf.json
provenance sidecar beside it. The scene holds the parts the build passes through (particles, sounds, sound environments,
fog volumes, wall marks, patrol paths, respawn points, environment modifiers and entity spawns) and the level's glows
and lights; no geometry yet

```txt
xrf-cli level decompile [OPTIONS] --path <path> --dest <dest>
```

| Option              | Required | Default | Description                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `-p, --path <path>` | yes      |         | Path to the level's directory, holding level, build.lights, level.game, level.ps_static and the rest                                    |
| `-d, --dest <dest>` | yes      |         | Path of the .level to write; its parts go in the directory beside it named after it, its sidecar beside it, and its name is the level's |
| `-f, --force`       |          |         | Overwrite an existing .level, its parts and its sidecar                                                                                 |
| `-s, --silent`      |          |         | Turn off logging                                                                                                                        |
| `-v, --verbose`     |          |         | Turn on verbose logging                                                                                                                 |
| `--json`            |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to stdout, moving human output to stderr                                                                    |
| `--report <PATH>`   |          |         | Write the run's JSON report to a file                                                                                                   |
